title: Natural transformation with the specified refinement-restriction components
statement:
∃ θ : ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ push R r.hom) ⋙ pull R d.i ⟶
        (openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i,
      ∀ M, θ.app M = refinementRestriction R r hi M

proof.text: Construct the proved private categorical helper counitRestriction: for functors L : A → B, P : B → A, F : B → C, G : A → C and natural transformations ε : P ⋙ L → 𝟭 B and α : G → L ⋙ F, the maps α.app (P.obj M) followed by F.map (ε.app M) form a natural transformation P ⋙ G → F. The proof uses α.naturality, ε.naturality, Functor.map_comp and associativity. The proved private helper exists_counitRestriction_of_eq whisks this transformation by K : S → B and identifies any specified equal component family. For the geometric specialization, open the compactification and refinement records and substitute the open-triangle equality; this avoids expensive conversion through refinementPull. Apply the generic existence helper to refinementRestriction.eq_def. Its α is refinementPull.hom, its ε is the specified derived adjunction counit, and K is the derived open extension. No invertibility or shift assertion is used.
